claude_proposed_widenings.name: hp_threshold_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Word's save-failure branch resolves differently based on the target's current HP at cast time (four threshold tiers: 0–20, 21–30, 31–40, 41–50). There is no mechanism in any existing ActivationPhase, Effect, or resolution atom to branch on runtime HP state after a save gate fires. This is a new conditional subgraph: save_gate → on_fail → hp_threshold_gate → per-tier effects.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: a target that has 50 Hit Points or fewer suffers an effect based on its current Hit Points, as shown in the Divine Word Effects table.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: kill
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The 0–20 HP tier causes instant death ('The target dies'), not a fixed damage amount. This is qualitatively distinct from the damage atom — there is no dice roll, no HP pool deduction, just a state transition to dead. No v4 effect atom covers unconditional instant kill.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: creature_type_predicate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The secondary effect (planar banishment) applies only to targets of specific creature types: Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend. There is no creature-type concept in the v4 atom inventory — no filter, predicate, or restriction atom operates on creature type. This is needed to express the conditional scope of transport_exile.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Regardless of its Hit Points, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend target that fails its save is forced back to its plane of origin.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection.any_chosen_in_range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Word targets 'each creature of your choice in range' with no fixed count limit. The existing TargetSelection modes are 'one' (single target) and 'choose_up_to' (count bounded by SlotScaling). An open-ended multi-target selection — all creatures the caster designates, up to the range limit — needs a new mode.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature of your choice in range makes a Charisma saving throw.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.apply_condition (for spells, with duration)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The HP-tier effects apply conditions (blinded, deafened, stunned) for timed durations (1 hour, 10 minutes, 1 minute). The spell Effect type only admits DamageEffect and NoneEffect. The apply_condition atom exists in v4 and is used in mastery SaveGateRiderResult, but it is absent from the spell Effect union and carries no duration field.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The target has the Blinded, Deafened, and Stunned conditions for 1 hour. / The target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions for 10 minutes. / The target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: blinded | deafened | stunned
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently only contains 'prone'. Divine Word applies blinded, deafened, and stunned — all standard SRD conditions. The Condition union must be widened to include these.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Blinded, Deafened, and Stunned conditions for 1 hour.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.transport_exile (for spells)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 taxonomy includes transport_exile as an effect atom, but it is not a variant of the spell Effect union (which only has DamageEffect | NoneEffect). Planar banishment 'forced back to its plane of origin and can't return for 24 hours' maps directly to transport_exile but cannot currently be expressed in a SpellRecord.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend target that fails its save is forced back to its plane of origin (if it isn't there already) and can't return to the current plane for 24 hours.
